name: native-baselines-vast-init-fixed15

initialization.inherit: common backbone, compatible alignment heads and ITM; optimizer fresh

warmup.backbone: frozen eval; same deterministic cached pretrained features

objective.vast: native symmetric T-VA contrastive CE; label smoothing .1
objective.gram: native symmetric negative Gram-volume CE; label smoothing .1
objective.pmrl: native intra+global-batch inter spectral losses; tau1=.05 tau2=.1
objective.itm: joint only: .1 native three-group CE; 1 positive and 2 sampled negatives

precision.failed_update: bounded same-batch RNG-preserving retry; no skipped updates

inputs.train_order: torch.randperm(seed50+epoch); same global batches at every world size

evaluation.task: T<->VA; all fixed captions; native ITC score and ownTop32 pure ITM; no score fusion
evaluation.primary_selection: maximum validation ITM R1, then ITC R1, then earlier epoch; no test-based selection

checkpoints.best: validation-selected joint model; fixed15 budget, no early stop
checkpoints.retention: save every epoch; keep best ITM/ITC and latest; keep final15 after completion; all metrics retained

limitations: One seed; matched added steps are not identical FLOPs
All methods use the same VAST initialization, not their released method-specific checkpoint
Current geometric method has different newly initialized heads and head hyperparameter search budget
No native entailment-cone metric for these baselines
Fixed audiovisual cohorts are not full paper benchmark protocols
Exact cross-hardware bitwise reproducibility is not promised
learning_rate_policy: unchanged prefix of original9660-step head/8050-step joint schedules; no peak-LR change or cosine compression
